title: Your Pre-Workout Has 1.5g of Beta-Alanine. The Studies Used 4-6g.
description: That tingle you feel is not the dose working. Beta-alanine raises muscle carnosine through saturation, which takes 4-6 g a day for two to four weeks. Plenty of pre-workouts put 1.5-2 g in a scoop. Our free dose checker compares what you take against the range the trials actually used, for 11 supplements. #BetaAlanine #PreWorkout #Supplements #EvidenceBased #FuelnFitHub
